sources.title: README.md · open-thoughts/OpenThinker3-7B at main
sources.snippet: It represents a notable improvement over our previous models, OpenThinker-7B and OpenThinker2-7B, and it outperforms several other strong reasoning 7B models such as DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B and Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Nano-8B-v1, despite being trained only with SFT, without any RL. This time, we also released a paper!

sources.title: OpenThoughts3 - A new SOTA Reasoning Data Recipe
sources.snippet: Conclusion Our OpenThinker3-7B model and associated OpenThoughts3-1.2M are the SOTA open-data model and SFT dataset for reasoning models, respectively. Our data pipeline is built on the insights gained through rigorous and comprehensive experimentation across the entire protocol.
